_comment: Oldest installed app (native shell) each UI bundle runs on. Bump it to the release version whenever a release changes native code the UI depends on: a new Capacitor plugin or native method (phone), or a new Electron version, preload API or main-process feature (desktop). Older apps are then offered the full download instead of the quick update. See docs/UPDATES.md.
_minVersion: minVersion: apps whose installed shell is older than this see a blocking Update required screen (the full download). It compares the shell, not quick updates, so keep it at or below the bundles' shell versions or everyone is forced to reinstall.
